This is completely false. Candace was obviously hostile to Erika from very early on, but was running a Mean Girls shtick of pretending to be someone's friend while obviously attacking her in subtle ways. 

She did concern trolling, actively ridiculing the idea that Charlie would want his wife to take over. https://t.co/7EsxkHQAa9

She also made sweeping statements that would obviously include Erika without naming her ("They all betrayed him," etc.). In October she explicitly called Charlie's death a "regicide" to "install a new ruler whom the king would’ve never approved of.”

https://t.co/jRrppwC3iq

And of course, the entire "Egyptians plane" quackery was obviously meant to attack Erika by implying her involvement in some intelligence plot.  

But the most obvious point where Candace flipped to attacking Erika is immediately after Erika asked her to "stop" during a Fox News appearance. 

https://t.co/hYu4ZuYWbU
https://t.co/CdVhhl4W48

It's ridiculous to look at all of the above and claim that Candace "stood by Erika" until meeting her. She transparently was just gradually ratcheting up attacks on her over time. People should stop falling for her lies.
